readerCopy.summary: One unexpected departure breaks the narrative and hijacks the news cycle.
readerCopy.body: One unexpected departure breaks the narrative and hijacks the news cycle. Prepared talking points collapse as every interview and internal message turns toward why the person left and what happens next. The Sun keeps every camera fixed on the person or decision at the center, while Uranus makes the break from expectation immediate and impossible to contain. Under the conjunction, the rupture becomes the new direction before anyone can restore the earlier script. The move may feel liberating to some people and leave others questioning whether the shock served the work or only the person who caused it.
